species: The Mascot search engine (Mascot 2.2.04, Matrix Science, Boston, MA) was used to search the human proteome in the Swiss-Prot database (20,279 reviewed protein sequences, September 2013) without enzymatic restriction.

disease_state: Immune cell infiltrates have proven highly relevant for colorectal carcinoma (CRC) prognosis, making CRC a promising candidate for immunotherapy.
sample_source: Primary CRC (HLA-class I: n=30; HLA-class II: n=19) and corresponding non-malignant colon (NMC, HLA-class I: n=35; HLA-class II: n=20) tissue samples were obtained from surgical specimens (Suppl. Table 1).
age: The study cohort (Suppl. Table 2) comprised 15 women and 22 men (median age 69 years; 27-85 years at surgery).
